name: Default Helix Sidecar
description: Standard OTLP gRPC + HTTP receiver, batch processing, forwarded to Helix. Recommended starting point for most apps.

name: Prometheus Scrape + OTLP
description: Adds a Prometheus receiver that scrapes a target endpoint, useful for legacy apps that already expose /metrics.

name: Tail Sampling for High-Volume Tracing
description: Adds a tail_sampling processor that keeps errors and slow traces, drops the rest. Use when trace volume is overwhelming.

name: Kubernetes Attribute Enrichment
description: Adds k8sattributes processor to enrich telemetry with pod/namespace/node metadata. Use when running in Kubernetes.
